name: Change of Status to F-1 (COS to F-1, Form I-539, incl. F-2 → F-1)
name_pt: Mudança de Status para F-1 (COS para F-1, Formulário I-539, incl. F-2 → F-1)
name_es: Cambio de Estatus a F-1 (COS a F-1, Formulario I-539, incl. F-2 → F-1)

phases.name: Document Collection & Review
documents: Previous USCIS receipts or approval (if any)
Sponsor ID / personal information / signed letter (if applicable)
Current I-94, passport, visa, receipt/approval, SEVIS payment (if already F-1/F-2)
Marriage/birth certificate (if applicable, current F-1 case)
DSO letter about current progress at school
documents_pt: Recibos ou aprovações anteriores da USCIS (se houver)
Comprovante de endereço atual nos EUA
Identidade/informações do patrocinador, carta assinada (se aplicável)
Diploma e histórico do ensino médio
I-94, passaporte, visto, recibo/aprovação, comprovante SEVIS (se já é F-1/F-2)
Certidão de casamento/nascimento (se aplicável, caso F-1 atual)
Carta do DSO sobre progresso atual na escola
documents_es: Recibos o aprobaciones anteriores de USCIS (si los hay)
Comprobante de domicilio actual en EE. UU.
Identificación/información del patrocinador, carta firmada (si aplica)
I-94, pasaporte, visa, recibo/aprobación, comprobante de pago SEVIS (si ya es F-1/F-2)
Acta de matrimonio/nacimiento (si aplica, caso F-1 actual)
Carta del DSO sobre el progreso actual en la escuela
steps: If sponsor: in the U.S. or home country?
For F-2 to F-1: explain why the change is legitimate and how it supports a real, credible career and academic plan
Gather proof of ties to home country (family, residence, employment, academic history)
Confirm academic history is consistent with the study plan

phases.name: Case Preparation
steps: Draft explanation letter (reason for COS) + B-2 photos

pricing.notes: Baseline = Language School variant. The same contract also prices a College variant higher: Standard $700, Plus Online $1,395, Plus Paper $1,520 — quote the College price when the client is transitioning to a college/university program instead of a language school.
pricing.source: Real Saes Professional Services contract (Downloads/Contratos), extracted 2026-08-02.
